summary: DRDGOLD Limited, a South African gold tailings retreatment company, furnished a Form 6-K with the SEC containing its Annual Integrated Report 2026, ESG Report 2026, and Notice of Annual General Meeting 2026, covering the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, or strategic action is disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer annual reporting and meeting-notice package, the US equivalent of an annual report and proxy circular. Board recommendations, advisors, and deal mechanics are absent; no risk-arb angle applies.
